menu.title: Foul Fowl: Fly, Flock, Forage, Fight
menu.quit_confirm: Quit the game? One More Turn is a different button. It appears after you win.
credits.1: For eXplorminate, with affection: a small galaxy, a finished evening, and the swans exactly as guilty as charged.
credits.2: No balance patch was applied to the swans. This was a decision.
menu.preset.tiny.name: Tiny
menu.preset.evening_standard.name: Evening Standard
menu.preset.evening_standard.sub: Twenty-four stars. One sitting. Bedtime intact if you are honest.
menu.preset.evening_standard.seats: Seats the Swans, one early-war empire and one schemer. Play one of them yourself and a random empire takes the empty chair.
menu.toggle.seat_swans.tip: Put The Pale Supremacy in the galaxy. On by default. Turning it off is an easier game, and you know it.
difficulty.nestling.name: Nestling
difficulty.nestling.tip: AI empires get -25% industry and research and never attack you first. For learning the birds.
difficulty.flighted.name: Flighted
difficulty.flighted.tip: The standard game. No handicap for either side. If you lose, it is yours.
difficulty.honk_admiral.name: Honk Admiral
difficulty.honk_admiral.tip: AI empires get +20% industry, +20% research, and can see your ship designs. Printed cheats: be angry at the number.
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.name: Lights-Off Ledger
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.tip: AI empires get +40% industry, +40% research, +20% growth, and can see your designs, colonies and fleets. Every modifier is printed. None of them are gentle.
race.swans.name: The Pale Supremacy
race.swans.pitch: Better than you at the thing you were about to do, and already bored of the demonstration.
race.pheasants.name: The Ringneck Warrant
race.pheasants.pitch: A victory lap that learned to file flight plans.
race.ducks.name: The Dabble League
race.ducks.pitch: If it has a shoreline, they have a rate card.
race.geese.name: The Marked Airspace
race.geese.pitch: They were here first. The property line was the honk.
race.owls.name: The Night Parliament
race.owls.pitch: They have read the tree. They are waiting on you to finish the tutorial.
race.penguins.name: The Pebble Throne
race.penguins.pitch: They already colonized the iceball you filtered out.
race.crows.name: The Open Murder
race.crows.leader: Keeper of the Cache, Kestra Nightcache
race.crows.pitch: Your tech is in circulation. They are the circulation.
race.chickens.name: The Pecking Order
race.chickens.leader: Prime Rooster Cluckett of the Ninth
race.chickens.pitch: Someone has to build the galaxy. They voted, by pecking, that it would be them.

special.old_nest.name: Old Nest
special.old_nest.tip: The first empire to colonise this planet receives one low-tier tech it does not have.
special.pretty_rocks.name: Pretty Rocks
special.pretty_rocks.tip: +5 credits a turn. Shiny, and it sells.
special.rude_wealth.name: Rude Wealth
special.rude_wealth.tip: +10 credits a turn. The soil is showing off.
special.kind_soil.name: Kind Soil
special.spare_nest.name: Spare Nest
special.spare_nest.tip: A colony founded here starts with 2 pop instead of 1.
special.yard_scrap.name: Yard Scrap
building.grand_nest.name: Grand Nest
building.grand_nest.tip: Your capital. +3 food, +5 industry, +3 research, +5 credits, +2 scan range, and ships can be built here.
building.the_yard.name: The Yard
building.boot_barracks.name: Boot Barracks
building.boot_barracks.tip: Garrison of 4 marines against invasion, regrowing 2 per turn.
building.feed_hall.name: Feed Hall
building.feed_hall.tip: +2 food, whatever the climate thinks of farming.
building.research_roost.name: Research Roost
building.research_roost.tip: +1 research per scientist and +3 flat. Labs that lab.
building.horizon_perch.name: Horizon Perch
building.horizon_perch.tip: Planet defence: 3 launchers firing your best Horizon missile, unlimited ammo.
building.colony_mantle.name: Colony Mantle
building.richer_dirt.name: Richer Dirt
building.second_clutch.name: Second Clutch
building.tireless_picks.name: Tireless Picks
building.tireless_picks.tip: +1 industry per worker and +5 flat. Robots: they do not call in sick, and they do not start religions.
building.loud_abacus.name: Loud Abacus
building.loud_abacus.tip: +1 research per scientist and +5 flat. A machine that interrupts the scientists, productively.
building.more_perch.name: More Perch
building.more_perch.tip: +1 max population per planet size at this colony.
building.talon_batteries.name: Talon Batteries
building.talon_batteries.tip: Planet defence: 4 Primary-mounted beams of your best Talon.
building.seed_exchange.name: Seed Exchange
building.gravity_manners.name: Gravity Manners
building.gravity_manners.tip: Removes this world's gravity penalty to job output.
building.night_lab.name: Night Lab
building.night_lab.tip: +10 research, whether or not anyone is on shift.
building.climate_lever.name: Climate Lever
building.climate_lever.tip: +1 food per farmer. Weather, by policy.
building.ugly_perch.name: Ugly Perch
building.ugly_perch.tip: Orbital fortress: 400 hull, 6 of your best Talons, your best ship shield. Ships built here cost 10% less.
building.flock_brain.name: Flock Brain
building.flock_brain.tip: +2 research per scientist at this colony.
building.storm_mantle.name: Storm Mantle
building.storm_mantle.tip: Planet shield 10. Bombardment damage cut to a quarter.
building.deep_scratch.name: Deep Scratch
building.second_shift_hall.name: Second Shift Hall
building.second_shift_hall.tip: +1 industry per worker and +3 flat. The night crew does not care about your narrative arc.
building.roost_gate.name: Roost Gate
building.roost_gate.tip: Fleets travel between any two of your Roost Gates in one turn.
building.departure_roost.name: Departure Roost
building.departure_roost.tip: The Exodus victory project. Everyone is told when you start it. Finishing it wins the game.
filler.trade_goods.name: Trade Goods
filler.trade_goods.tip: Converts half of industry output into credits.
filler.research_project.name: Research Project
filler.research_project.tip: Converts half of industry output into research.
notify.strike: Treasury empty. Strike: industry -25% next turn.

role.talon_line.name: Talon Line
role.talon_line.tip: Beam warship. Fights at Talon range, the middle of the strip.
role.beak_line.name: Beak Line
role.beak_line.tip: Kinetic warship. Fights at Beak range, point blank.
role.horizon_boat.name: Horizon Boat
role.horizon_boat.tip: All missiles, no beams. A hull that tells the truth about what you think combat is.
role.swat_escort.name: Swat Escort
role.swat_escort.tip: Swat Mounts that shoot down incoming missiles. Bring one when the autopsy said Horizon.
role.boot_ship.name: Boot Ship
role.boot_ship.tip: Troop transport for invasions. Marines, in a can.
role.nest_ship.name: Nest Ship
role.nest_ship.tip: Colony ship. Founds a colony and is spent on landing.
role.stake_ship.name: Stake Ship
role.stake_ship.tip: Outpost ship. Plants an outpost that extends your fuel range.
role.glance.name: Glance
role.glance.tip: Scout. Cheap, unarmed, built for Auto-Explore.
part.wick_talon.name: Wick Talon
part.wick_talon.tip: Talon, 3-8 damage. The starter beam: it starts fights and finishes none.
part.sun_quill.name: Sun Quill
part.sun_quill.tip: Talon, 5-12 damage. Fusion, in a straight line.
part.banded_glare.name: Banded Glare
part.banded_glare.tip: Talon, 8-18 damage. It arrives in stripes, and the stripes are not decorative.
part.last_glare.name: Last Glare
part.last_glare.tip: Talon, 14-32 damage. The best beam there is. The Guardian of Orn flies six.
part.peck_driver.name: Peck Driver
part.peck_driver.tip: Beak, 5-9 damage, shields count half. Best delivered point blank.
part.clatter_bill.name: Clatter Bill
part.clatter_bill.tip: Beak, 9-15 damage. Many small opinions, quickly.
part.gizzard_bore.name: Gizzard Bore
part.gizzard_bore.tip: Beak, 14-24 damage. It grinds. Range is a courtesy it declines.
part.anvil_beak.name: Anvil Beak
part.anvil_beak.tip: Beak, 20-34 damage. The heaviest gun in the game, if you can get close.
part.hatch_dart.name: Hatch Dart
part.hatch_dart.tip: Horizon, 5 damage, 3 salvos. The first missile a navy learns to throw away.
part.ink_dart.name: Ink Dart
part.ink_dart.tip: Horizon, 9 damage, +10 accuracy, 3 salvos. The invoice, in a hurry.
part.cited_dart.name: Cited Dart
part.cited_dart.tip: Horizon, 13 damage, +15 accuracy, 3 salvos. More citations, same destination.
part.indoor_torpedo.name: Indoor Torpedo
part.indoor_torpedo.tip: Horizon, 30 damage. Unlimited ammo, fires every other round. Indoor voices were requested.
part.primary_mount.name: Primary Mount
part.primary_mount.tip: Talon mount: double space, x1.5 damage, half the range falloff.
part.swat_mount.name: Swat Mount
part.swat_mount.tip: Talon mount: half size, half damage, +20 accuracy. Shoots down incoming missiles.
part.walk_drive.name: Walk Drive
part.walk_drive.tip: Map speed 2, combat speed 1. You are walking, and everyone can see it.
part.current_drive.name: Current Drive
part.current_drive.tip: Map speed 3, combat speed 2. A polite speed.
part.fold_drive.name: Fold Drive
part.fold_drive.tip: Map speed 4, combat speed 2. Space, pinched. The pinching is licensed.
part.migration_drive.name: Migration Drive
part.migration_drive.tip: Map speed 6, combat speed 3. The drive you leave the galaxy with.
part.pinfeather_plate.name: Pinfeather Plate
part.pinfeather_plate.tip: No hull bonus. Armor, as a suggestion.
part.joined_plate.name: Joined Plate
part.keel_plate.name: Keel Plate
part.keel_plate.tip: Hull x2. The bone, worn on the outside.
part.marrow_plate.name: Marrow Plate
part.marrow_plate.tip: Hull x2.75. Dense enough that the drive notices.
part.unsinkable_plate.name: Unsinkable Plate
part.unsinkable_plate.tip: Hull x3.5. The argument is settled.
part.dust_cover.name: Dust Cover
part.dust_cover.tip: Shield 2: every hit does 2 less. Stops a rude remark and very little of a missile.
part.half_mantle.name: Half Mantle
part.full_mantle.name: Full Mantle
part.full_mantle.tip: Shield 6: every hit does 6 less. Most of the evening stays outside.
part.closed_season.name: Closed Season
part.closed_season.tip: Shield 9: every hit does 9 less. Nothing is in season.
part.pecking_logs.name: Pecking Logs
part.pecking_logs.tip: Computer, +10 accuracy. It remembers who bit whom.
part.predictive_peck.name: Predictive Peck
part.predictive_peck.tip: Computer, +20 accuracy. The shot leads the duck. The ducks have complained.
part.grudge_ledger.name: Grudge Ledger
part.grudge_ledger.tip: Computer, +30 accuracy. Accuracy with a memory.
part.preened_cognition.name: Preened Cognition
part.preened_cognition.tip: Computer, +40 accuracy. The ship thinks. The union has questions.
part.nest_pod.name: Nest Pod
part.nest_pod.tip: Founds a colony. Takes 1 pop from the colony that builds it; spent on landing.
part.perch_pod.name: Perch Pod
part.perch_pod.tip: Plants an outpost, which extends your fuel range.
part.boot_pod.name: Boot Pod
part.glance_pod.name: Glance Pod
part.rude_sun.name: Rude Sun
part.rude_sun.tip: Bomb. Twice a Bomb Bay's bombardment, for that kind of guest.
part.very_polite_warhead.name: Very Polite Warhead
part.very_polite_warhead.tip: Planet-killer bomb: eight Bomb Bays' worth, ignores planet shields. It observes the forms. Then it is a sun.
part.roost_bracing.name: Roost Bracing
part.miss_field_1.name: Miss Field I
part.miss_field_1.tip: Incoming missiles get -20 accuracy against this ship.
part.miss_field_2.name: Miss Field II
part.miss_field_2.tip: Incoming missiles get -40 accuracy against this ship.
part.loadout_glance.name: Loadout Glance
part.lean_in.name: Lean-In
part.crop_tanks.name: Crop Tanks
part.self_sealing_nest.name: Self-Sealing Nest
part.self_sealing_nest.tip: Repairs 10% of max hull every round. The ship apologizes to itself and continues.
part.gone_to_molt.name: Gone to Molt
part.gone_to_molt.tip: Cannot be targeted in rounds 1 and 2. Still fires. This is legal.
part.not_this_feather.name: Not This Feather
part.not_this_feather.tip: 25% of hits on this ship miss outright.
part.orn_plating.name: Orn-Plating
part.orn_plating.tip: Hull +40%, shield +2. Salvaged from the Guardian of Orn; only its killer may fit it.

notify.nest_drained: A Nest Ship launched and took 1 pop with it.
ui.fleet.doomstack_tip: Eight or more ships in one fleet. You may rename it back. Brenda will not respect the rename.

refuse.design_loot: Only the empire that took this part can fit it.

refuse.no_pod: This fleet carries no Nest Pod or Perch Pod.
refuse.not_here: The fleet must be at the target planet's star.
battle.plan.swat.tip: Swat Mounts: shoot down incoming missiles first, or fire at ships like any other gun.
role.horizon_line.name: Horizon Line
role.horizon_line.tip: Missile warship. Fights at Horizon range, the far end of the strip.
refuse.no_bombs: Fleet does not contain any bomb parts.
refuse.no_marines: Fleet does not contain any Boot Pods.
refuse.defenses_active: Colony defenses must be suppressed before invasion.
refuse.guarded: System is guarded by a powerful entity.
refuse.not_at_war: Not at war with this colony owner.
notify.invasion_won: {place} is yours. It is occupied, and it remembers the previous owner.
notify.invasion_lost: The landing at {place} failed. The marines are not coming back.
battle.autopsy.title: Battle Autopsy
battle.autopsy.standout: {ship} did more of it than anyone.
battle.autopsy.receipt: Retreat held. {ship} was last out, and is gone.
battle.orders.title: Battle Orders
battle.orders.projection: Closing: Talon range by round {talon_round}, Beak by round {beak_round}
ui.battle_line.tip: Line ships take the field up to line capacity; reserves wait behind.
ui.retreat.receipt_tip: Retreat works on round two, and it always leaves someone last.
monster.guardian.name: Guardian of Orn
monster.guardian.roar: Turn around. Your century is thin, and I am still on the nest.
monster.guardian.warning: At the core, something old is still on its nest and finds your century thin. It offers one warning volley and the dignity of turning around.
monster.leviathan.name: Leviathan
monster.leviathan.roar: No roar. A jiggle, with purpose, in your direction.
notify.guardian_marked: Guardian-Marked for ten turns. Your weapons are ten percent less convincing. You were offered a volley and a chance to leave.
news.leviathan: A soft moon with opinions has drifted into a lane, hungry and badly defined. Your scouts report that it jiggles with purpose.

personality.sportsman.name: The Sportsman
personality.dealmaker.name: The Dealmaker

diplo.swans.greeting: You may speak. A moment has been allotted.
diplo.swans.threat: We dislike doing this. We dislike doing it poorly more.
diplo.swans.peace: Stop. The border may remain where you placed it.
diplo.swans.defeat: How novel. Write it down. No one will believe you.
diplo.pheasants.threat: We can do this the sporting way.
diplo.pheasants.peace: Pins back in. Do not preen as if it were your idea.
diplo.pheasants.defeat: A fair loss. We hate it. Name the rematch.
diplo.ducks.greeting: Welcome to the puddle. We have rates.
diplo.ducks.threat: We would rather invoice you. The other document is also ready.
diplo.ducks.peace: Ceasefire, plus three percent, plus you stop shooting the couriers.
diplo.ducks.defeat: Back in the spring. Try not to drain the pond.
diplo.geese.greeting: This is our air. State your business.
diplo.geese.peace: We stop if you stay off the lane and out of the mood.
diplo.geese.war: You were warned at the property line.
diplo.geese.defeat: We are going back to the pond. Do not follow.
news.war: {a} and {b} are at war. The ticker is practising the names.
news.capitulation: {name} has knelt. The colonies changed hands between sentences.
capitulation.card.title: The rest of the nest.
capitulation.card.body: {leader} has lost the capital and is down to a remnant. Accept, and what they still hold is yours.
victory.conquest.body: The lanes are quiet, which is one way to hear a win. The Perch Review will call it decisive, and for once they will be using the small word.
victory.called_game.body: Time, bird. The horizon got here first. You may press the other button. You may also be done.
victory.one_more_turn: We are not your alarm clock.
defeat.capitals_gone: The nest is ash and the lanes are someone else's. There is a rematch in the same galaxy seed, if the evening still has room.
defeat.called_game: The horizon arrived before the comeback. The comeback has been noted in the margin.
defeat.as_swans: Historic upset. The galaxy has framed the scoreboard. Scholars are unhappy. Good.
defeat.as_pheasants: A fair loss. We hate it. The rematch button is the sporting one.
defeat.accepted_supreme_bird.body: The minutes list you as present. You accepted. History will list you as nearby.
victory.banner.against_swans: Against the swans. Tell your hatchlings.
budget.peace.name: Peace
budget.guarded.name: Guarded
budget.war.name: War
diplo.reason.value: The numbers work on our side.
diplo.reason.distrust: We do not sign research treaties with you. The lock is the point.
diplo.reason.coalition: There is a list, and you are on it.
diplo.reason.pledge: Our vote is already in a pocket.
diplo.reason.tribute: You can afford to be polite.
diplo.reason.territorial: No pact until you have beaten us or paid us.
diplo.reason.relation: We do not like you enough for this paper.
diplo.reason.exodus_locked: Not for sale. A previous galaxy tried.
diplo.reason.backstab: You broke a treaty where people could see.
diplo.reason.war: We are already shooting. Odd time to ask.
diplo.reason.price: The rate for you is worse. You know why.
refuse.not_met: We have not met this empire.
refuse.truce: A truce is currently in effect.

summary.news.title: News
ui.fleet.swat_options.tip:
Missiles: shoot down incoming missiles before they hit.
Ships: fire at enemy ships only.
ui.fleet.colonize.tip: Found a colony on a planet here
ui.fleet.colonize.none_tip: No planet here your species can colonize
ui.fleet.outpost.tip: Plant an outpost here to extend fuel range
ui.fleet.outpost.none_tip: No planet here for an outpost

autopsy.title: Battle Autopsy
autopsy.flavor.1: {victor} held the field. {loser} held a grudge.
autopsy.flavor.2: Read the band. It decided this before anyone pressed Skip.
autopsy.flavor.3: {ship} did the work. The rest of the fleet was present.
autopsy.flavor.4: Retreat works. It always leaves someone last.
autopsy.flavor.5: {loser} brought the wrong range to the right fight.
autopsy.flavor.6: The tier list was consulted. {victor} was on it.
autopsy.flavor.7: The autopsy writes itself. It paused less than you did.
autopsy.flavor.8: Shields subtract. Swats swat. Beaks need to be close. Someone forgot one of those.
autopsy.flavor.9: {victor} will call this decisive. The Perch Review will use the small word.
autopsy.flavor.10: Luck was involved. So was the design screen. Check the second one.
autopsy.flavor.11: Orbit belongs to {victor}. The paperwork belongs to {loser}.
autopsy.flavor.12: Nobody is OP at a range they never reached.
battle.orders.automated.title: Automated Battles
battle.orders.automated.body: These fights use each fleet's standing battle plan:
ui.battle.range_strip.tip: Beak 0-3, Talon 3-7, Horizon 7+. Each side moves toward its posture's range; same speed still closes one step a round, faster closes sooner.
